english.title: Fail to remove item worn on demand by a constable

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: CRIMINAL JUSTICE AND PUBLIC ORDER ACT
CRIMINAL JUSTICE AND PUBLIC ORDER ACT 1994

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed to remove an item when required to do so by a constable in uniform authorised under section 60AA of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994, the constable having reason to believe you were wearing the item, namely **(..SPECIFY ITEM..), wholly or mainly for the purpose of concealing your identity
english.legislation: Contrary to section 60AA(7)of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994.

english.notes:
(i) A power to seize the item(s) removed is provided - subsection 60AA(2)(b)
(ii) This offence was inserted into the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994 by section 94 of the Anti-terrorism, Crime and Security Act 2001.

other.penalty:
